main.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Architectural interior concept visualization for SYNK Korean-language and K-culture academy, Ulaanbaatar. Create ONE polished landscape diptych showing the SAME main 66sqm rectangular classroom/studio (10m wide x6.6m deep) in two opposite viewing directions. Two spacious photographic panels separated by a slim white gutter. No title, captions or people. This is material/lighting concept, not construction drawing.
LEFT panel from south-east looking toward NORTH: a wide full-wall mirror covered completely by a straight off-white neutral grey full-height acoustic curtain, a large mobile interactive display on a stable low-profile wheeled mount in front of curtain, 16 separate compact individual rectangular desks arranged four rows of four, pale natural ash/oak tops, slim matte-black legs with locking casters, charcoal stacking chairs, generous central teacher sightline. No shared bench tables. Ceiling off-white acoustic finish with tidy linear lights, small ceiling-mounted camera above center aisle, tidy concealed cables. Matte light neutral-grey resilient dance flooring, not glossy. Bright even neutral-white teaching illumination, no windows invented, no daylight dependence. One low storage section flush against side wall.
RIGHT panel from north-east looking toward SOUTH in content-shooting mode: the same room's opposite wall is matte charcoal/black fine acoustic panels, centered coral #F96859 acrylic channel-letter LED sign using the exact lowercase wordmark shape of the supplied image as geometric reference (preserve its distinctive y descender and raised k, DO NOT use its cream felt material; this physical sign is solid coral acrylic with internal LEDs). Soft white face-lighting pointing toward the activity floor, restrained coral glow on sign only, no nightclub lighting. Open activity floor foreground with furniture stored in compact folded/nested groups along a side storage wall, no furniture magically disappearing, no claim of exact storage capacity. Black track rails/soft panels high on ceiling, matte light-grey floor matching left panel. In the far side edge a hint of north mirror curtain. A little white purifier and humidifier separated along walls, no visible vapor.
Aesthetic: premium contemporary creative academy, clean restrained industrial precision with warm wood touch, credible human-scale affordable fitout, refined Korean rehearsal studio, excellent physical materials. Straight verticals, eye height camera, architectural photography, realistic lens no fisheye, soft shadows, no excessive decorative props, no sofa, no lobby, no neon slogans, no marble luxury, no purple glow. Source image only supplies exact synk letter geometry for the physical sign.

rooms.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE architectural interior material-study sheet of six different rooms in the SAME contemporary SYNK language academy. A very clean 3-column by 2-row contact sheet, equal rectangular photographic panels, slim pure white gutters; each panel has one tiny black identifying letter in its top-left corner ONLY, exactly B, C, D on top row and O, V, P on bottom row. No other text or brand logos. No people. This is atmospheric material design, not a measured floorplan, no dimensions or layout claims. Show useful furniture close enough to appreciate the detail. Straight verticals, realistic compact rooms with no invented windows.
Shared language: white painted walls, white acoustic ceilings, matte pale natural ash/oak, slim black metal hardware, washable light-grey floors, neutral grey felt acoustic panels with fine actual stitched details, quiet neatly concealed wiring. Human-scaled, refined Korean creative academy, restrained and practical, high-quality photography, eye-level natural lens, neutral illumination. Not beige hotel, not kindergarten, not sci-fi, no lush plants or decorative clutter, no glowing strip lights everywhere.
Panel B: bright compact study room, a corner perspective with a large dark digital display on teaching wall, compact separate single-person pale-oak desks and charcoal chairs facing it, neat grey acoustic panel with a small thin Lapis blue #3D6BC9 embroidered seam and a small matching door tag. White walls dominate, no blue-painted room.
Panel C: same-family study room furniture, white wall with horizontal low oak storage and neutral grey fabric acoustic panel with one small thin Meadow green #7DB45A embroidered seam, individual desks facing digital display. Calm yet youthful. No green-painted room.
Panel D: compact study classroom in horizontal arrangement, white walls, individual desks facing display on LEFT wall, neutral grey fabric panel with thin Butter yellow #F5C445 seam and small yellow room tag, pinrail with 3 tidy student sheets, no shared group tables. No yellow-painted room.
Panel O: compact office for eight staff, view showing two rows of FOUR genuinely separate individual desks each, pale wood desktops, ergonomic charcoal chairs, tidy matching monitors, white closed upper storage, neutral fabric acoustic panels. No oversized executive desk, no couches, no central communal table, no coffee machine.
Panel V: a very small narrow consultation room converted to VR activity mode, about 2.6m wide by4.1m deep, white walls, one light oak fold-down consultation tabletop FULLY folded vertically flat against side wall, FOUR folded chairs stored vertically in a neat wall rack at the near end, a compact locked ventilated VR equipment charging cabinet at the near corner, blank clear central floor for one person with a subtle square grey mat roughly2x2m. No sofa, no person, no desks or obstacles inside the mat, no exposed glass wall or visible vapor. Soft even lighting, no RGB. Show clear zone, fold furniture visibly at edges.
Panel P: very narrow2.15m wide photo/refreshment room, depth4.1m. View from doorway shows short coffee and wrapped-snack counter length1m on the RIGHT NEAR wall with a compact coffee machine, separated from rear photo equipment by a short solid splash/divider panel. Far rear photo backdrop neutral grey with one coral #F96859 curtain pulled to the side; compact camera-screen kiosk facing the backdrop on LEFT farther in, tidy soft portrait lighting. No lounge or stools, no bar seating, no huge countertop, no liquids near photo gear, no huge room.
Colors on textile stitching and small signs only; white and neutral materials carry the rooms. Make each of six panels distinct yet visibly related. Visually precise material library quality.
